== Summary ==
The SWCCG Players Committee logo, as the PC prints it beside the (AI) / (ALT) alternate-image stamp at the bottom right of its Virtual cards (for example [[Aayla Secura (Holo AI)]]). Shown in the '''Alternate-image stamp''' row of [[Template:Card]] (swccg-guild/work#100).

Source: the logo on the Players Committee's February 2024 Game Aid sheet (starwarsccg.org), upscaled 4× and cropped to the logo.
